name: Strange tracks
subject: Scouts
text: Your Scouts found strange tracks leading into the mountains

outcomes.text: Your Scouts followed the tracks to a forgotten shrine
Your Scouts followed the tracks, and one never came back
Your Scouts left the tracks alone
Your Scouts left the tracks alone, and whoever made them raided your caravans

name: Rumours of war
subject: Nation
text: Rumours spread of a large army marching on your Nation

name: Outbreak
subject: Nation
text: Sickness broke out in your Nation

outcomes.text: You quarantined the sick
You quarantined the sick, but the sickness slipped past the guards
Your healers spent their learning on the sick
Your healers spent their learning on the sick and found a cure
You let the sickness spread
You let the sickness spread, but it soon burned itself out

name: Bandits
subject: Nation
text: Bandits are raiding your roads

outcomes.text: You paid the bandits to move on
You paid the bandits, and they came back for more
Your people hunted the bandits down
The bandits ambushed your hunters
Your people hunted the bandits down and seized their loot
You ignored the bandits and they plundered freely
You ignored the bandits, and they moved on to richer lands

name: Travelling merchants
subject: Nation
text: Travelling merchants offer you books from distant lands

outcomes.text: You bought the merchants' books
You bought the merchants' books, but most were forgeries
You turned the merchants away
You turned the merchants away, but a scholar among them stayed to teach

name: Refugees
subject: Nation
text: Refugees fleeing war have gathered at your border

outcomes.text: You fed and housed the refugees
You fed and housed the refugees, but most moved on before winter
You closed the border to the refugees
You closed the border, but some refugees slipped across and settled

name: Flood
subject: Nation
text: Heavy rains have the rivers rising

outcomes.text: You raised levees against the flood
You raised levees, but the river broke through them
You evacuated the lowlands, though some were lost
You evacuated the lowlands in time, and no one was lost
You hoped the flood would pass, and it swept the lowlands away
You hoped the flood would pass, and the rains stopped just in time

name: Tax revolt
subject: Nation
text: Your people are protesting against your taxes

outcomes.text: You lowered taxes
You lowered taxes, but the protesters demanded more
You crushed the revolt
You tried to crush the revolt, and it spread to your cities
You ignored the protests and riots broke out
You ignored the protests, and they died down on their own

name: Crumbling Buildings
subject: Nation
text: Your engineers warn that your defensive Buildings are crumbling

outcomes.text: You paid the masons to shore up your defensive Buildings
You paid the masons, but their work was shoddy
You left your defensive Buildings to crumble
You left your defensive Buildings be, and they held for now

name: Border dispute
subject: Nation
text: A neighbour is disputing your borders

outcomes.text: You negotiated a settlement
You negotiated a settlement, but paid dearly for it
You stood firm, and your neighbour backed down
You stood firm, and fighting broke out along the border
You conceded land, and lost the people living on it
You conceded land, but few lived on it

name: Drought
subject: Nation
text: Drought is drying up your rivers

outcomes.text: You dug wells
You dug wells, but had to dig deep to find water
You rationed water
You rationed water, but not strictly enough
You prayed for rain, and none came
You prayed for rain, and the skies opened

name: Festival petition
subject: Nation
text: Your people are petitioning you for a festival

outcomes.text: You held a grand festival
You held a grand festival, but rain spoiled it
You held a modest festival
You held a modest festival, but few came
You refused the petition, and some of your people left in disgust
You refused the petition, and the grumbling soon died down

name: Foreign envoy
subject: Nation
text: An envoy from a distant land has arrived at your court

outcomes.text: You showered the envoy with gifts, and they shared their learning
You showered the envoy with gifts, but they had little to teach
You sent the envoy home with modest gifts
You gave the envoy modest gifts, and they demanded more
You sent the envoy away
You sent the envoy away, and their people raided your borders in revenge

name: Deserter's secrets
subject: Nation
text: A deserter from a distant land offers to sell you its secrets

outcomes.text: You paid the deserter for their secrets
You paid the deserter, but their secrets were worthless
You turned the deserter away
You turned the deserter away, and your scholars wasted time chasing the rumours they spread

name: Cracked foundations
subject: Nation
text: Your engineers have found cracks in the foundations of your defensive Buildings

outcomes.text: You reinforced the foundations
You reinforced the foundations, but the cracks ran deeper than your engineers thought
You patched up the cracks
You patched up the cracks, but one of your defensive Buildings gave way anyway
You left the cracks, and your defensive Buildings gave way
You left the cracks, and they held for now
